DDTL 2.0.text: CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. IV, LLC (CCAC IV). Original credit agreement dated 16 May 2024 for commitments of up to $7.5 billion; the amended facility is described as up to $7.6 billion, subject to collateralization. Contractual terms: quarterly installments due from January 2026, final payment due five years after each loan was funded (terms, not evidence of payments made). Parent guarantee dated 16 May 2024
DDTL 2.0.document: S-1 Ex. 10.13; IPO prospectus (424B4); Form 10-K for 2025; S-1 Ex. 10.16
DDTL 2.0.where: Ex. 10.13 recitals, p. 1; 424B4 p. 123; 10-K Note 10, p. 115; Ex. 10.16 preamble

DDTL 2.0.text: "to finance the (a) IG Capital Expenditures and (b) Non-IG Capital Expenditures", including portions of the Acquisition and related transaction costs; the defined expenditure terms refer to infrastructure, ancillary components and installation

DDTL 2.0.entry: What the issuer says it financed
DDTL 2.0.text: Purpose (prospectus): "entered into primarily to finance capital expenditures required to perform customer contracts, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure" (pp. 197, 212); intended use, future tense: borrowings "will be used to finance a portion of the purchase consideration, fees, and expenses relating to the acquisition of computing equipment" (p. 123). Actual use, stated jointly for DDTLs 1.0, 2.0, 2.1 and 3.0 (10-K): borrowings "are used to finance a portion of the purchase considerations, fees, and expenses relating to the acquisition of computing equipment", with capacity sized on the depreciable cost of GPU servers. No statement attributes a GPU purchase amount to DDTL 2.0 alone

Substantially all of CCAC IV's assets and 100% of its equity pledged, subject to exceptions; CoreWeave, Inc. guarantees "as a primary obligor", subject to §2.1(b); listed under recourse debt at 30 Sep 2026
DDTL 2.0.document: IPO prospectus (424B4); S-1 Ex. 10.16; Form 10-K for 2025; Form 10-Q Q3 2026

DDTL 2.0.text: In the facility sections examined: no CCAC IV-only collateral amount (the Q3 2026 10-Q gives one aggregate for certain special-purpose subsidiaries without naming them), no GPU-only allocation of proceeds, no link to named customers

DDTL 4.0.text: CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC (CCAC VIII); signed 30 Mar 2026; $8.5 billion commitment, of which up to approximately $7.5 billion initially drawable, increasing as assets reach stabilization; availability ends on the earlier of commitments reaching zero and 30 Jun 2027; matures 31 Mar 2032

"finance the acquisition and installation of Infrastructure in connection with the Project"; also liquidity and power reserve accounts and fees, premiums and expenses; top-up draws may fund distributions if the top-up debt-sizing criteria hold. Infrastructure (excerpt) includes "any graphics processing unit servers and ancillary components, including networking infrastructure and other hardware". For subsequent draws other than top-up draws, CCAC VIII must deliver purchase orders for the new infrastructure being acquired (§4.02(l); the initial funding and any Top-Up DDTL Draw are excepted). This is evidence the lenders require for a draw; the itemized orders are not in the filed materials examined, so what was bought is not publicly itemized
DDTL 4.0.where: §3.11, p. 63; "Infrastructure", p. 26; §6.06(f), p. 82; §4.02(j), (l), (m), (p), p. 70; Schedule 4.02(l) listed p. v

DDTL 4.0.entry: What the issuer says it financed
DDTL 4.0.text: Purpose at signing: "primarily to finance capital expenditures required to perform a customer contract, including the acquisition of GPU servers and related infrastructure" (8-K). Actual-use category each quarter: borrowings "are primarily used to finance the acquisition and installation of computing infrastructure and related fees and expenses" (10-Qs). Neither gives a GPU-only dollar amount

Substantially all assets of CCAC VIII and its subsidiaries; 100% of CCAC VIII's equity pledged by CCAC VIII Holdco LLC; the Master Services Agreement and data-center leases/licenses are carved back from Excluded Collateral; control agreement over the MSA-revenue account at initial funding. Guarantees: CCAC VIII's subsidiaries guarantee unconditionally; CoreWeave, Inc. guarantees only listed bad acts (the loan is non-recourse except for these carve-outs). Pledged CCAC VIII assets at 30 Sep 2026: $5.2bn non-current (primarily PP&E, net) and $233m current (primarily accounts receivable)

Customer agreement and data-center site identifiers redacted; the form of collateral agreement (Exhibit J) is listed but the attached form is omitted from the filing; in the loan documents and financial statements examined, no GPU-only proceeds figure, no detailed CCAC VIII PP&E composition and no recorded top-up distribution
DDTL 4.0.where: Ex. 10.1 pp. 13, 28; Exhibit J listed p. v; 8-K Item 9.01; 10-Q Q1 2026 Note 10 p. 25; Q2 2026 p. 29; Q3 2026 pp. 32-33

2025-12-31 · What was financed.text: The Company entered into various agreements with original equipment manufacturers (the "OEM Financing Arrangements"), whereby the Company obtained financing for certain equipment with an aggregate notional balance of $4.8 billion and $1.3 billion as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

2025-12-31 · Outstanding OEM equipment f.text: The Company had an outstanding balance of $3.8 billion and $1.2 billion as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

2025-12-31 · What secured it.text: The Company granted a security interest for the financed equipment related to these financing arrangements.

2025-12-31 · Software-licence financing.text: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company also entered into various arrangements with a software license vendor (the "Software License Financing Arrangements"), whereby the Company obtained financing for certain software licenses with an aggregate notional balance of $431 million as of December 31, 2025, and may elect to finance up to an additional $884 million of optional tranches under the terms of one arrangement that commenced in October 2025.

2026-09-30 · What was financed (Q3 2026).text: The Company had entered into various agreements with original equipment manufacturers (the "OEM Financing Arrangements"), whereby the Company obtained financing for certain equipment.

2026-09-30 · Outstanding OEM equipment f.text: The Company had an outstanding balance of $7.4 billion and $3.8 billion as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.

2026-09-30 · Outstanding software-licenc.text: The Company had an outstanding balance of $278 million and $368 million as of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively.

2026-09-30 · Security terms restated in.text: Not restated: the Q3 2026 OEM paragraph (p. 34) gives balances but does not repeat the security-interest sentence.
